title: Major environmental groups are embracing AI to analyze climate data, track forest fires, and more, even as they warn of the environmental impact of data centers (Valerie Volcovici/Reuters)
summary: Valerie Volcovici / Reuters: Major environmental groups are embracing AI to analyze climate data, track forest fires, and more, even as they warn of the environmental impact of data centers — Environmental groups worldwide are using artificial intelligence to analyze climate data, track forest fires and count endangered wildlife …
